title: Goldman Sachs, SocGen buy Rs 920 crore stake in Lenskart
excerpt: Goldman Sachs and Societe Generale have jointly invested ₹920 crore to purchase a 1% stake in Lenskart Solutions, acquiring 65.21 lakh and 61.76 lakh shares priced at ₹725 each. Steadview Capital Management facilitated this by selling an equivalent number of shares, resulting in their stake decreasing from 3.31% to 2.58%. Following this, Lenskart’s stock slid approximately 4%, ending the day at ₹715.90.

title: PhonePe resumes IPO process; targets February-March listing at $12-15 billion valuation
excerpt: PhonePe has resumed its initial public offering plans after deferring them due to market uncertainties. The company aims for a stock market listing valued between USD 12-15 billion in early 2024. It expects to raise approximately Rs 12,000-14,000 crore through an offer-for-sale. The digital payments firm has also reported significant revenue growth and is now profitable at the group level.

ai.title_te: PhonePe IPO పునఃప్రారంభం: 2024 ఫిబ్రవరి‑మార్చి లో $12‑15 బిలియన్ విలువ
ai.summary: PhonePe మార్కెట్ అనిశ్చితి కారణంగా వాయిదా వేసిన IPOని పునఃప్రారంభించింది. 2024 ఫిబ్రవరి‑మార్చి లో $12‑15 బిలియన్ విలువతో, Rs 12,000‑14,000 కోట్లు రైజ్ లక్ష్యంగా పెట్టుకుంది. కంపెనీ గ్రూప్‑లెవెల్‌లో లాభదాయకంగా ఉంది.

title: Shapoor Mistry lobbied Modi twice for Tata Sons IPO as battle over listing intensifies

title: Fed policymakers at odds over causes of high inflation
excerpt: US inflation is expected to increase again in October, with potential implications for Federal Reserve interest rate decisions. Economists predict the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index to reach 3.8% this month. Analysts are divided regarding whether inflation is caused by demand or supply shocks stemming from recent policies. Market forecasts suggest three more rate hikes, signaling ongoing concerns about rising prices.

title: US Treasury gains lift India bonds ahead of RBI meet
excerpt: On Wednesday, Indian government bonds rallied, influenced by a decrease in US Treasury yields. The benchmark 10-year bond yield fell to 7.1641%, marking a two-week low. The Indian rupee strengthened to its highest level for the fiscal year against the dollar. Overseas investors returned as net buyers of Indian debt, purchasing over 93 billion rupees. The Reserve Bank of India's upcoming decision will significantly affect market movements and trends.

title: Sebi mulls early payout of up to 80% of sale proceeds to FPOs in commodity derivatives market
excerpt: Sebi introduced a proposal for an early pay-out framework designed to assist Farmer Producer Organisations. This framework would allow FPOs to access up to 80 percent of sale proceeds before contract expiry. The initiative aims to alleviate liquidity challenges by providing timely payments to farmers. Corporate trading members will offer this facility based on certain conditions and net worth requirements. Public comments on the proposal are invited until December 16.

title: RBI net buyer of dollars for fourth straight month in September, data shows
excerpt: The Reserve Bank of India recorded net purchases of $6.94 billion in the foreign exchange market during September. It bought a total of $82.18 billion while selling $75.25 billion in currency transactions. Despite a decline in the rupee, capital inflows reached about $143 billion due to various measures. Indian equities have recently attracted investors, leading to a rise in the rupee's value.

title: Corporate bond fundraising set for record in FY27 despite rising borrowing costs

title: GDP, (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits, 3rd Quarter 2026
excerpt: Real gross domestic product (GDP) increased at an annual rate of 4.3 percent in the third quarter of 2026 (July, August, and September), according to the second estimate released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). In the second quarter, real GDP increased 2.2 percent. The contributors to the increase in real GDP in the third quarter were increases in investment, consumer spending, and government spending that were partly offset by a decrease in exports. Imports, which are a subtraction in the calculation of GDP, increased.

title: Personal Income and Outlays, October 2026
excerpt: Personal income increased $201.8 billion (0.7 percent at a monthly rate) in October, according to estimates released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). Disposable personal income (DPI)–personal income less personal current taxes–increased $200.5 billion (0.8 percent), and personal consumption expenditures (PCE) increased $63.8 billion (0.3 percent). Personal outlays–the sum of PCE, personal interest payments, and personal current transfer payments–increased $69.3 billion in October. Personal saving was $1.00 trillion, and the personal saving rate–personal saving as a percentage of DPI–was 4.1 percent.

title: Two in five Indian family offices, UHNIs have engaged with crypto amid regulatory caution
excerpt: Around 41 percent of high-net-worth investors in India are delving into the world of cryptocurrencies and virtual digital assets, despite many only possessing a fundamental comprehension of this evolving landscape. Regulatory ambiguity poses a significant hurdle, with 59 percent expressing concerns. Investors frequently turn to informal channels, such as peer networks and social media, for insights on digital assets.

title: RBI Bulletin – November 2026
excerpt:
Today, the Reserve Bank released the November 2026 issue of its monthly Bulletin. The Bulletin includes six speeches, four articles and current statistics.

title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade due to severe weather
excerpt: Macy's announced Wednesday that its annual Thanksgiving Day Parade is being postponed to Saturday due to severe weather.
